description: Reflection's Apache 2.0 open-weight text model with 501.3B total and 23.4B active parameters, built for coding, reasoning and tool use. It supports a shared 1,048,576-token context window, up to 131,072 output tokens, JSON mode and structured output. Reasoning is always enabled with low, medium, high, xhigh and max effort; NanoGPT defaults to max. Knowledge cutoff: June 30, 2026.
name: Beam 1.0 501B A23B
